entry_state: The portable registry now covers review, time selection, compilation, history operations, uncertainty evaluation/admission/selection, scenario projection, accounting assessment/authorization/proposal/commit, reporting, explanation, resume and storage exchanges. The common envelope owns expected-head information. Closed accounting-record definitions begin next and remain unfinished.
exit_state: Closed basis, authorization and commit records bind one event and its evidence, with synthetic and real book modes distinct. Methods and extensions require explicit preconditions, schemas and immutable locks. The OrderedEPS report reference now specifies exact contexts, inventories, series timing, rational arithmetic, result traces and failure statuses; documentary results mutate no accounting state.
findings: The accounting record blocks are legible and preserve same-basis/same-authorization links between journal and independent economic delta.
Method registration does not establish accounting applicability; empty authority lists make no authority claim.

The EPS reference supplies its own serialization, positive denominator and context binding, disallows silent series omission, and preserves independently ready basic EPS when dilution is unresolved or unsupported.
The EPS code block continues over a page boundary without losing its syntactic structure; the surrounding text explains temporal windows, no-effect rows and result precedence.
